sentences.text: No, the documents say a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on business-purpose loans to Micro and Small Enterprises with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh, and this applies to loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.
Your case facts match that rule because the borrower is mse, the purpose is business, the bank is Tier 3 UCB, the amount is ₹4,000,000, and the sanction date is 2026-03-15.
The documents also state that no pre-payment charges which have not been disclosed as specified may be charged by a UCB.
